facts.doc_title: Electrical Isolation and Access to Switchgear
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The authorisation of switching and access to apparatus shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a material unwanted event control. This clause applies to activities archived under ELECTRICAL-SAFETY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
